# Version 4.154.0
> **Documented APIs and GPU reliability** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.154.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 packages compiler XML documentation and improves GPU failure handling on Skia m154. This release also synchronizes HarfBuzz enum values and Uno WebAssembly native assets. Built-in RAW/DNG decoding is no longer available.

## Breaking Changes

- **Decode RAW and DNG images outside SkiaSharp** — Built-in DNG development and PIEX-based embedded RAW-preview decoding are disabled. Use an external RAW decoder and pass decoded pixels or an extracted JPEG to SkiaSharp. Standalone JPEG decoding remains available; SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng is retained for compatibility but does not indicate codec support. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))
- **Use the corrected HarfBuzz combining-class name** — Replace UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 with CCC132. The numeric value remains 132, but there is no compatibility alias for the old name. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Combine concrete HarfBuzz glyph flags** — GlyphFlags.Defined is removed. Combine the concrete flags needed by your application instead of relying on an aggregate mask of all flags known to a particular HarfBuzz version. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Stop referencing generated Blazor imports** — The generated SkiaSharp.Views.Blazor._Imports type is no longer shipped after the canvas components moved to source-controlled C#. Remove direct references to this generated imports artifact and reference the canvas components instead; existing canvas markup and rendering behavior are unchanged. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064))

## Engine

- **Skia m154** — Updates the renderer to milestone 154 while preserving the existing C exports and managed P/Invoke surface. Native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1; its .400 package revision distinguishes this milestone's package set. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **Packaged IntelliSense documentation** — Ships source-authored compiler XML beside implementation and reference assemblies, with matching documentation in lib and ref assets. Packages with reference assemblies are checked for missing or mismatched XML sidecars. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080))
- **HarfBuzz enum coverage** — Synchronizes supported buffer, cluster, glyph and baseline-tag values with the bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 source, without introducing new managed types or exposing callback-heavy native API families. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU text and failed-work handling** — Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking and propagates failed render tasks and prerequisite flushes through existing failure contracts. Checked GPU-buffer upload failures reject affected draws, and failed flushes evict uniquely held cache entries that could reference uninitialized textures. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114), [#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
- **Uno WebAssembly native assets** — The Uno WinUI views package depends on matching HarfBuzz WebAssembly assets, preventing link failures caused by pairing current managed imports with Uno's older implicit native archive. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim compatibility** — Corrects the BA2007 disabled-compiler-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll on x86, x64 and ARM64 without changing its native exports. — ❤️ [@azchohfi](https://github.com/azchohfi) ([#5111](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5111))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

Synchronizes supported enum values with HarfBuzz 14.2.1, including the CCC133-to-CCC132 rename and removal of GlyphFlags.Defined. Also fixes Windows BinSkim BA2007 compatibility, matches Uno WebAssembly native assets and supplies compiler XML documentation.
